tools.name: search_notes
tools.description: Find the published passages that answer a question. Returns the best passage quoted word for word (when one answers it), the notes that cover the question, and passages close in meaning, each with its URL. Give note to search inside one note.

tools.name: get_note
tools.description: Return one field note in full as Markdown (title, date, topic, every section and its FAQ), exactly as published.

tools.name: related_notes
tools.description: List the notes closest in meaning to a given note, with their published descriptions.

tools.name: latest_notes
tools.description: List the most recently published notes, newest first, optionally within one topic.

tools.name: list_topics
tools.description: List the topic guides, each with its published description, premise and the slugs of its notes.
